decisions.evidence: Dshi_2434 is 'rhamnose ABC transporter, periplasmic rhamnose-binding protein'. It is co-transcribed with its cognate monosaccharide ABC permeases (Dshi_2431, Dshi_2432) and the two-NBD ATPase (Dshi_2433) in the rha cluster; this is the specific rhamnose transporter, as an AND-complex.
Dshi_2436 'rhamnulose-1-phosphate aldolase/alcohol dehydrogenase' (bifunctional RhaD) in the rha cluster names this exact aldolase.

Dshi_1153 'nitrite/sulfite reductase hemoprotein beta-component' is co-transcribed with PAPS reductase CysH (Dshi_1152), with siroheme CysG (Dshi_1155) nearby, which fits assimilatory sulfite reductase. Nitrite assimilation is by NirBD (Dshi_1667/1668).
This is a lumped multi-enzyme thiazole reaction. Dshi_0153 is a generic FAD-dependent oxidoreductase (family-level), so neither R1 nor R2 applies.
No thiamine-monophosphate kinase (ThiL) is annotated. Dshi_2739 'thiamine pyrophosphokinase' catalyses a different reaction (thiamine to TPP).
Dshi_2155 is phosphoglycerate kinase (EC 2.7.2.3, ~393 aa, no TPI fusion). Keep triose-phosphate isomerase Dshi_2078.
